statements.subject: session
statements.description: The IDLE command remains active until the client responds to the continuation, and as long as an IDLE command is active, the server is now free to send untagged EXISTS, EXPUNGE, FETCH, and other responses at any time.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The IDLE command is sent from the client to the server when the client is ready to accept unsolicited update messages. The server requests a response to the IDLE command using the continuation ('+') response.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The IDLE command is terminated by the receipt of a 'DONE' continuation from the client; such response satisfies the server's continuation request. At that point, the server MAY send any remaining queued untagged responses and then MUST immediately send the tagged response to the IDLE command and prepare to process other commands.
actions: server sends remaining queued untagged responses
server sends tagged OK response to IDLE command
server prepares to process other commands

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MAY consider a client inactive if it has an IDLE command running, and if such a server has an inactivity timeout, it MAY log the client off implicitly at the end of its timeout period.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client MUST NOT send a command while the server is waiting for the DONE, since the server will not be able to distinguish a command from a continuation.
